dt-api.name: stateRestore.states().details()
dt-api.summary: Get the details for the selected states

type.description: Get a list of the selected states.
type.returns: Returns a DataTables API for chaining which contains objects of type `-type StateRestore.State`.

dt-api.description:
This method can be used to get the details of all selected states. The objects in the returned data set are of type `-type StateRestore.State`.
As with `-api stateRestore.state().details()`, please note that mutating the state object is not currently supported - don't write values to it as there is no API to tell StateRestore that they have changed. The objects in the result set are considered to be _read-only_.

example.title: Print out the details for two selected states
